resources.string: After a factory reset, Android may still remember a Bluetooth pairing. Find the radio in your device’s Bluetooth settings and forget it, then try pairing again. Settings names vary by device.
You can also clear all MeshCore One companion device registrations below. This may remove a Bluetooth bond, but you may still need to forget the radio in Bluetooth settings.
No companion registrations found. A Bluetooth pairing may still exist.
The PIN was not accepted. If the radio appears in Bluetooth settings, forget it there. Check the PIN, then tap Remove and Try Again.
The saved pairing with this radio stopped working. If the radio appears in Bluetooth settings, forget it there, then tap Remove and Try Again.
